method: Every evaluation image was inspected in a 1280 px contact-sheet tile; labels are an AI first pass, not human ground truth.

decisionLegend.removable: visible satellite/aircraft-like trail should be removable
decisionLegend.protected: visible meteor or star trail should be preserved
decisionLegend.mixed: protected content and removable trail coexist
decisionLegend.unsuitable: diagram, illustration, composite, irrelevant scene, or otherwise unsuitable
decisionLegend.ambiguous: visual evidence is insufficient for an evaluation label
